*Submitting a photo?* (Data collection tasks only — you can submit 1 at a time.)

    *1.* Complete the task's objective
    *2.* Go to the @TaskBot DM channel here on Slack
    *3.* Type the task number and attach that task's image (see below)

*4.* Send the message! Compensation is added to your account immediately.

*Verification tasks?* Just click *Agree* or *Disagree* on the message — no need to type anything.
🌸 Reply `?` or `help` for more info or to report a bug! 🌸
